descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S06 「体温边界值经过 Save Note 的提取：只写数字的 °C 保持 °C，什么都不换算」 Temperature boundaries through Save Note's extraction: bare °C stays °C, nothing converted

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 A bare Celsius temperature stays in °C (PR #48); no unit is guessed for an ambiguous value.（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 6；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Five dictations with one temperature each, across the ≤ 45 (°C) and ≥ 90 (°F) bands main uses, plus a bare weight

When Each dictation goes through ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes with the app's context and client guards

Then The stored temperature keeps the dictated number; a bare Celsius number is never labelled or converted to °F; a bare Fahrenheit number is not converted to °C; the bare weight gets no unit

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Per case fieldIncludes / fieldNotIncludes / displayNotIncludes on vitals.temp and vitals.wt; all 5 must pass (deterministic expectation on dictated numbers). Reported as 'model + exported guards', not as the app's write path

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
